mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.v_device_config ORDER BY device_id
SELECT group_name FROM public.tb_device_group WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, group_name
SELECT device_id AS "deviceId", station_id AS "stationId" FROM public.tb_device WHERE device_name = #{equipId} LIMIT 1
SELECT device_id AS "deviceId", station_id AS "stationId", group_id AS "groupId" FROM public.tb_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
SELECT group_id FROM public.tb_device_group WHERE group_name = #{groupName} LIMIT 1

SELECT g.group_id AS "groupId", g.group_name AS "groupName", g.sort_order AS "sortOrder", COUNT(d.device_id) AS "deviceCount" FROM public.tb_device_group g LEFT JOIN public.tb_device d ON d.group_id = g.group_id WHERE g.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name, g.sort_order ORDER BY g.sort_order, g.group_name
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_device_group SET group_name = #{groupName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_device WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
